name: A Man for All
source:
After three years of attending college at Sol City institute in the big city, you’re just one step away from your college degree. Your last obstacle? Your undergraduate thesis.

Now it’s up to you to explore the city, meet new people, and complete your biggest academic assignment yet.

Hot babes. Sexy encounters. Wacky hi-jinks. Heartfelt relationships. Experience it all. But only if you’re… a man for all.​
